policies.title: Password Reset
policies.content: Employees can reset their own password via a self-service portal. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, IT must be contacted for a manual unlock; no approval is required.

policies.title: VPN Access
policies.content: VPN access is automatic for full-time employees. Contractors need manager approval via an access request form. Credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed.

policies.title: Laptop Replacement
policies.content: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service or earlier due to verified hardware failure. Requests need to be raised at least 2 weeks in advance.

policies.title: Software Installation Requests
policies.content: Standard software (from an approved catalog) can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review (3-5 business days).

policies.title: Printer Troubleshooting
policies.content: For printer issues, first check the queue and restart the spooler. If the problem persists, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.

policies.title: Email Mailbox Quota
policies.content: Default is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.

policies.title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
policies.content: Credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket is required.

policies.title: Expense Software Access
policies.content: Access is granted by Finance, not IT. IT assists with login/technical issues once an account exists.

policies.title: Security Incident Reporting
policies.content: Suspected phishing, malware, or unauthorized access attempts must be reported immediately to security@veridian-corp.example and not forwarded to others.

policies.title: Work-From-Home Equipment
policies.content: Employees working remotely more than 3 days/week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance (chair, monitor). Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing; IT handles shipping after approval.

policies.title: Asset Management Policy
policies.content: All company-issued hardware (laptops, monitors) follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle. Early replacement requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
